{{Quote|You're a Jedi?''"<br />"''A Sith.''"<br />"''I thought the Sith were extinct.''"<br />"''Not yet.''"<br />"''Let me see if I can fix that.|Set Harth and Darth Zannah|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>}}
This '''duel''' took place in [[Set Harth's mansion]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[980 BBY]] between [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]]. Zannah, who had tracked Harth to his home on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], was hoping to enlist him as her apprentice before she challenged [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], for the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. She dueled Harth, and, impressed with his skills, decided to use [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] to defeat him and serve as his final test; if he awoke from the comatose state in which her [[Summon fear|powers]] left him, she would take him on as his apprentice. Harth was reluctant to join her but, realizing that she would kill him if he did not, he accepted her request.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|A few days ago a man with long white hair arrived on Doan. Did he come through this port?''"<br />"''Oh, yeah. I remember him. Nice ride. State of the art shuttle. Custom interior. Top of the line. Even nicer than yours.|Darth Zannah and Pommat|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />}}
[[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] was sent on a [[Mission to Doan|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] in [[980 BBY]] to find out who was responsible for the [[Massacre on Doan|murder]] of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]]. While on Doan, she discovered evidence that a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] had been there searching for [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. Zannah knew that the time was coming for her to attack her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], and so she hoped to test this Dark Jedi to see if he was worthy to be her apprentice. After conferring with [[Quano]] and [[Pommat]], she used several of her other contacts to track the Dark Jedi, whose name she discovered was [[Set Harth]], to [[Set Harth's mansion|his mansion]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==The duel==
{{Quote|You move fast.|Set Harth to Darth Zannah, after she managed to dodge his initial attack|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />}}
Zannah arrived at his mansion while he was at a party. She confronted him upon his return; and he pretended to think that she was just someone who had followed him home from the party. Harth then abruptly activated his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Lightsaber combat|threw it]] at Zannah, who barely managed to dodge the blade. Harth then shot a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Wave|wave]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy at Zannah, who raised a [[Force barrier/Legends|protective barrier]] to block the blow. Harth then attacked her with his lightsaber and she ignited [[Bane's Heart (lightsaber)|her own]], deflecting his blows. Harth threw a burst at her with the Force, but Zannah deflected it and his next attack with ease.

Harth continued his attack, utilizing a version of the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] form [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]]. Harth quickly grew angered, but Zannah, utilizing her near-flawless expertise of the [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]] form, continuously deflected his attacks without difficulty. During the brief duel, she saw several openings in which she could have killed Harth, but she had come to test his worthiness as a potential apprentice; not to kill him. Zannah was impressed with his imagination, cunning, unpredictability, and undeniable strength in the dark side.

Harth's weariness soon overtook him, and Zannah kicked him in the chin. She requested that he yield, but he continued to attack. However, as he drew near, Zannah conjured a [[Sith sorcery/Legends|spell]] of [[Summon fear|fear]] and with it attacked Harth's mind. He attempted to block it with a Force barrier, but his defenses were not strong enough to halt Zannah's attack. Rather than unleashing the full intensity of her powers upon him, she enveloped him in despair and hopelessness, causing him to collapse into a coma-like condition. Zannah decided that if Harth was strong enough to recover, then she would take him as her apprentice.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Rule of Two dictates that there can only ever be two Sith, so how can you take me as an apprentice if your Master is still alive?''"<br />"''If you accept my offer, you will accompany me as I go to face my Master. But you must not interfere. If he falls, then I will take you as my apprentice.''"<br />"''What happens to me if you fall?''"<br />"''If I die, my Master will need a new apprentice. If he judges you worthy, then you will replace me. If not&hellip;|Set Harth and Darth Zannah|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />}}
As Harth regained consciousness, he began to wonder his next course of action, considering attacking Zannah, trying to catch her by surprise. Zannah, however, had been reading his mind, and warned him not to do so. Zannah revealed to the Dark Jedi that it had been three nights since their battle. Harth insisted that he had no idea what she wanted with him, and Zannah revealed that she was looking for an apprentice. She requested that he join her, and, although Harth was very reluctant&mdash;he did not care about the Sith, or defeating the Jedi&mdash;he realized that if he did not accept, she would kill him. On the other hand, he realized that being Zannah's apprentice could lead him on a path to greater individual power. Faced with this temptation, he agreed to join Zannah. However, they returned to Bane and Zannah's [[Darth Bane's mansion|home]] on [[Ciutric IV]] to find that Bane had been [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|captured]] by the [[Doan Royal House]].
